message:
We all know that one person who seems gloriously over-prepared for every little thing, right? I remember a family gathering when one of our friends arrived with a go-bag that could rival a small army's supply kit. It was filled with snacks, first-aid supplies, extra socks, and even a portable water filter! At first, we chuckled, but as the evening wore on, we found ourselves reaching for her stash during a surprise rainstorm. 

It made us think about the value of being a little extra prepared. Sure, we might not need a portable water filter for a picnic, but having a few essentials on hand can turn a minor hiccup into a minor inconvenience instead. Who knows, maybe we could all take a page from her book and start our own little stash! 😊
